notes: Every record is a genuine published file. Nothing here was generated, edited, or planted.
Public access alone is not treated as permission. Where no explicit reuse statement was located, redistribution is 'unknown' and the file is not committed.
sha256 is of the exact bytes downloaded on accessDate. Several URLs are 'live' files that the publisher regenerates; use the archive URL or the committed copy to reproduce.

records.title: Recent Monthly Mean CO2 at Mauna Loa Observatory
records.authors: NOAA GML (contact named in data file: Xin Lan)

license.basis: U.S. Government work (17 U.S.C. 105); NOAA GML data-use statement in the companion file: 'These data are made freely available to the public and the scientific community ... please include relevant citation text'.

records.selection: Whole image (single chart). Plot area only is the intended crop; title, axis labels, NOAA logo, and the rotated date stamp are outside the data region.

chart.type: line with markers (two series); black series has vertical error bars

series.label: black squares + line with error bars
series.meaning: deseasonalized monthly mean ('deseasonalized' column); bars correspond to uncertainty

reference.description: Same publisher's monthly data file co2_mm_mlo.csv (record noaa-co2-mm-mlo-csv-2026-10), rows 2021-01..2026-09, columns 'average' and 'deseasonalized'.
caveats: Data file and chart were generated by the publisher on the same date (2026-10-09); NOAA notes values may receive small QC revisions.
Error bar half-width semantics (unc vs sdev) are not labelled in the chart; do not score error bars.

exclusions: 2022-12 .. 2023-07 observations come from the Maunakea site, not Mauna Loa (publisher note); they are still the published values and are scored as-is.

records.title: Mauna Loa CO2 monthly mean data (co2_mm_mlo.csv)
records.publisher: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory; 1958-03..1974-04 records from Scripps Institution of Oceanography (C. D. Keeling)

license.basis: NOAA-measured records: U.S. Government work + GML 'freely available' statement (in file header). Scripps-originated records (1958-03..1974-04): Scripps terms not verified.
license.redistributionPermitted: yes for the NOAA-era excerpt; unknown for Scripps-era rows (excluded from the committed excerpt)

files.note: Full original; fetched by evaluation/fetch-inputs.sh. Live URL: the hash changes when NOAA regenerates the file.

files.derivation: Byte-verbatim lines of the original: every '#' comment line, the header line, and all data rows with (year,month) >= (1974,5). Command: awk -F, '/^#/ {print; next} /^year,/ {print; next} ($1>1974)||($1==1974 && $2>=5) {print}' co2_mm_mlo.csv. Verified with cmp against the original's data rows.

records.selection: Data records after the 40-line '#' comment preamble (record 41 is the header); header 'year,month,decimal date,average,deseasonalized,ndays,sdev,unc'.

reference.description: This file is itself the author-provided numeric record.

records.units: average/deseasonalized/sdev/unc in ppm; ndays = count of days
parserChallenges: 40 leading '#' comment lines (8 contain commas, so a naive CSV parser sees records with varying field counts) before the header record.

Negative sentinels mean 'not available', not negative measurements: ndays=-1, sdev=-9.99, unc=-0.99 (publisher note: interpolated months have negative stdev/unc). Examples in excerpt: 1975-12 and 1984-04 rows.
Decimal strings whose trailing zeros are significant text (e.g. unc '0.00', sdev '0.40'); they must survive as exact strings.

license.redistributionPermitted: yes for EIA content; the PDF is not committed only because of size (7.2 MB)
license.automatedOrModelProcessingPermitted: yes for EIA content; third-party futures series excluded from scoring
license.attributionRequired: acknowledgment requested: 'Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (Oct 2026)'

files.format: PDF 1.7, 60 pages, 612x792 pt, rotation 0, not encrypted

records.selection: PDF page 15 (one-indexed), upper chart only: 'West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude oil price and NYMEX futures price', dollars per barrel. Page 15 also contains a title slide and a second chart (world liquid fuels balance) which are outside the selection.

reference.description: EIA STEO October 2026 data workbook (record eia-steo-2026-10-xlsx), sheet '2tab', row 'WTIPUUS' (West Texas Intermediate Spot Average, dollars per barrel), monthly 2022-01..2027-12; 'Dates'!D7 marks 2026-09 as last historical month.

exclusions: 2021 months are plotted but have no reference in this workbook: not scored (reported as 'unreferenced', neither correct nor wrong).
Forecast months are scored separately from historical months and are projections, not observations.
observedSourceIssues: Page 5 table 'Notable forecast changes' labels Brent crude oil spot price as '(dollars per gallon)' while page 3 labels the same series '(dollars per barrel)'. Genuine inconsistency in the published PDF; useful as a real unit-ambiguity case. Not planted.

records.title: Short-Term Energy Outlook data workbook, October 2026 (base case)

license.basis: EIA Copyrights and Reuse statement (public domain; use and distribution permitted; acknowledgment requested).

records.selection: Sheet '2tab' (Table 2. Energy Prices). Data row 6 'WTIPUUS', columns C..BV (72 months).

reference.description: This workbook is the author-provided numeric record for STEO figures.

records.units: Per-row units in column B group headings, e.g. 'Crude Oil (dollars per barrel)'
parserChallenges: 28 sheets; the intended table is not the first sheet.
Two header rows: row 3 = year (formula cells '=Dates!D3' / '=AY3+1' with cached results), row 4 = month abbreviations.
Units are in a group-heading row above the series rows, not in a column.
Formulas with cached results must be identified as cached (product spec); formulas must never be executed.
Numbers are stored as doubles; displayed precision (number format) can differ from stored value (e.g. 83.9 vs 83.90).
